proof_scope: surf webgpt.reasoning-crawl captures reasoning from a live/past ChatGPT tab and rejects tabs with no reasoning.

claims.proves: The surf-integrated command captures a >100-char reasoning block from a tab that rendered reasoning, and returns captured:false for a tab that did not.
claims.does_not_prove: That every sidebar conversation has reasoning, grading quality, or overnight-run completion.

cases.name: surf-command-registered
command: cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."; python3 -c "import ast; ast.parse(open('scripts/webgpt-reasoning-crawl.py').read())" && grep -q 'webgpt.reasoning-crawl' run.sh && echo REGISTERED

cases.name: bogus-tab-no-reasoning
command: cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."; out=$(./run.sh webgpt.capture-reasoning --tab-id 999999999 --current-only 2>/dev/null); echo "$out"; echo "$out" | grep -q '"captured": false' && echo NOREASON_OK

cases.name: live-tab-captures-reasoning
command: cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."; T=$(./run.sh tab.list --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys;t=json.load(sys.stdin);t=t if isinstance(t,list) else t.get('tabs',[]);xs=[x['id'] for x in t if 'chatgpt.com/c/' in str(x.get('url',''))];print(xs[0] if xs else '')"); if [ -z "$T" ]; then echo NO_LIVE_TAB; exit 2; fi; out=$(./run.sh webgpt.capture-reasoning --tab-id "$T" --current-only 2>/dev/null); echo "$out"; echo "$out" | python3 -c "import json,sys;d=json.load(sys.stdin);sys.exit(0 if d.get('captured') and d.get('chars',0)>100 else 1)" && echo LIVE_REASONING_OK
